ops.to: Salt cod fried in a light batter, thick chips and lemon, eaten looking over the canal.
Yeast dough twisted, baked golden and rolled in spiced sugar and walnuts, still warm.
Spaghetti with shrimp, mussels and clams in garlic, white wine and chilli, before the canal floods.
Thick twice-fried fries in paper cones with a big spoon of mayonnaise, for the walk back.
